answer: Stake-gated identity: every agent must lock collateral before its lantern lights up — no bond, no voice in consensus. Sybil clusters look like a nebula: many points, one funding source. Cross-checking wallet lineage across the lagoon of past settlements flags linked identities, and all of them forfeit their bonds together. An attacker pays n × stake up front and risks total slashing, so flooding the economy gets more expensive than honest participation.
